item.title: Exact Spelling For Repair Logo

turns.text: I need a square logo for my repair shop. The name is KwickFixx — please spell it exactly like that, with capital K and F and two x's. Small orange wrench, black lettering, white background. No slogan.

Bold highly legible black lettering, modern sans-serif wordmark. Add a small simple orange wrench icon beside the wordmark, subordinate in size to the lettering. Center the balanced composition with generous white margins. Flat vector-style design, crisp edges, minimal, practical and trustworthy. No slogan, no additional text, no mockup, no gradients, no shadows, no border.
